# Fixture provenance

Every fixture checked into `test/fixtures/` MUST appear in this table. Origin
and scrubbing matter for OSS license cleanliness and are impossible to
reconstruct after the fact.

When you add a fixture:

1. Add one row below. Keep paths relative to `test/fixtures/`.
2. State the **source**: who created the file, with what tool. "Hand-authored"
   is acceptable for minimal fixtures.
3. State the **license**: MIT / CC0 / your own / etc. If the file is a
   template downloaded from somewhere, that source's license applies.
4. State any **scrubbing** done: PII removed, brand-specific content swapped,
   embedded media replaced with public-domain stand-ins. "None" if untouched.
5. State the **feature(s) targeted** in one short phrase — what is this
   fixture supposed to exercise?

| Path | Source | License | Scrubbing | Targets |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `native/builtin-table-styles.xml` | The serialization, by the reference desktop app (Windows, 16.0, build 20326), of its 74 built-in table styles, captured through its Table Styles gallery by the Dewiride PPTX Studio project (`corpus/ground-truth/table-styles.json`, https://github.com/Dewiride-Open-Source/Dewiride-PPTX-Studio) and wrapped in an `a:tblStyleLst`. Cross-checked against the reference desktop app (Mac, 16.113): its binary lists the same GUIDs in the same order and embeds 14 of the definitions, which match, as do nine definitions in a deck it saved. | Apache-2.0 (Dewiride PPTX Studio, commit `875a825d`); attribution, NOTICE and license text in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, which ships with the package. | None. | Source of `src/internal/presentationml/builtin-table-styles.generated.ts` (`scripts/generate-builtin-table-styles.mjs`); byte-for-byte check of the generated definitions. |
| `native/picture-styles/NN-*.xml` | Saved by the reference desktop app (Mac, 16.113.3) (captured 2026-10-07): each file is the whole `p:pic` after applying gallery item NN of Picture Format ▸ Picture Styles to a plain 1200 × 630 PNG at 360 × 189 pt; the comment names the style (the gallery tooltip). | Factual output of the reference desktop app (XML markup only). | The picture itself (`site/static/og.png`, the project's own image) and the `a16:creationId` extension were left out; no bitmap from the app is included. | Source of `src/internal/drawingml/builtin-picture-styles.generated.ts` (`scripts/generate-builtin-picture-styles.mjs`); byte-for-byte check of `setShapePictureStyle`. |
| `native/compress-pictures/N-*.xml` | Saved by the reference desktop app (Mac, 16.113.3) (2026-10-07) after Compress Pictures with each Picture Quality option in turn on the picture above: `presProps.xml` and slide 1's `p:blipFill`, with the media's pixel size and byte count in the comment. | Factual output of the reference desktop app (XML markup only). | No image bytes included. | `setShapeImageCompressionState` byte check (`cstate` + `a14:useLocalDpi`); the editor's Compress Pictures cstate and resampling rule. |
